approvalSource: Explicit project-owner approval in this task for Juhu v0.3 and the scoped two-locality beta publication workflow.
cloudMaskMethod: Cloud Score+ cs_cdf >= 0.60; valid B2/B3/B4/B8 masks; median clear composite
waterHandling: Composite NDWI > 0 excluded from the observed-land denominator; coastline, beach transition and lagoon-edge samples were rejected during review.
knownLimitations: The reviewed polygons are purposive image-reference samples, not field-verified ground truth.
Ten-metre pixels mix vegetation and built surfaces, especially in low-rise residential fabric.
The estimate is sensitive to threshold choice and is specific to this boundary, season, mask and calibration set.
Beach, lagoon and aerodrome-edge areas were excluded from calibration evidence; residual coastal mixed-pixel effects may remain.
scopeNote: Approval is specific to Juhu v0.3, the 2025-11-01 through 2026-02-28 window, this Sentinel-2 workflow and the reviewed v0.3 calibration samples. NDVI 0.30 is not a universal TreeScore threshold.
